responsibility: Implements GCC’s tree-level alias oracle for GIMPLE SSA. This file answers whether references may alias, whether statements or calls may clobber or use a reference, whether pointers can alias globals, and it provides walkers over virtual use/def chains; it also initializes and queries ao_ref descriptions, combines points-to information, alias sets, TBAA access-path logic, mod/ref summaries, and dependence information to drive memory disambiguation for optimizers across the tree-SSA pipeline.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation of the tree-SSA alias oracle itself, with the code that answers alias/clobber/use queries, walks virtual operands, computes statistics, and performs detailed ao_ref/TBAA/modref reasoning. By contrast, gcc/tree-ssa-alias.h is the API and data-structure declaration layer consumed by optimizers and by the separate structural points-to solver.
